user.title: Connect Mijia Geek Bridge
user.description: Enter the mijia-geek-bridge URL and API token. The Bridge owns the gateway session, so Home Assistant restarts do not require a new passcode.

reauth_confirm.title: Update Bridge API token
reauth_confirm.description: Bridge ({url}) rejected the current token. Enter a new token.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Bridge
reconfigure.description: Change the Bridge URL or API token.

error.invalid_url: The Bridge URL must start with http:// or https://
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Bridge

migrate_to_bridge.title: Mijia Geek integration needs reconfiguration
migrate_to_bridge.description: The legacy direct-connection entry was migrated to the Bridge client. Open the integration entry and choose Reconfigure to enter the Bridge URL and API token.
